unmapped.label: Software systems integration
unmapped.raw_text: integrating complex software systems into enterprise environments

parsed.notes:
The thrive and bring sections are required; the plus section is optional. The inline 'ideally' modifies the customer-facing or consulting environment, not the entire experience requirement.
Java and Python are both labeled despite being alternatives, as instructed for explicitly named technologies.
Software development lifecycle is interpreted literally as software-engineering knowledge; generic developer tooling, platforms, environments, infrastructure systems, and systems integration have no fitting taxonomy entries.
Curiosity about AI agents is not treated as a required technical skill; agent-framework experience is explicitly optional.
AI/LLM platforms is mapped to llms without inferring machine learning or AI infrastructure.
Governance, observability, security controls, and deployment technologies mentioned only in responsibilities or company description are excluded.
No German-language or degree requirement is stated.
